name: How long does a metal roof estimate take to complete?

mainEntity.name: How long does a metal roof estimate take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard metal roof estimate typically takes about 30 to 60 minutes for an on-site visit, followed by a few days to compile the detailed proposal. The time required can vary based on the roof's complexity and accessibility. For example, a multi-level roof with intricate designs may require a longer inspection than a simple gable roof.
acceptedAnswer.description: A metal roof estimate usually involves a 30-60 minute on-site visit, with the full proposal ready within a few days.
